content.title: Chapter 18 - BUILDINGS AND BUILDING REGULATIONS — Sec. 18-395. - I.P.C. Section 312.6, Gravity sewer test.
content.summary:
Section 312.6. Gravity sewer test,
is hereby amended in its entirety to read as follows:
"
312.6. Gravity sewer test.
Gravity sewer tests shall be conducted as set forth in the Arvada Engineering Standards."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 11, 9-14-2020)
